reasoning: Hero holds turned top set (TT) on 8h5c2dTc rainbow, OOP HU at SPR ~2.65 facing 33% IP probe after villain checked back flop. Per v3.4 line 729 HU carve-out, this is governed by v3.1 value/protection rules — Rule 11 multiway predicates do not trigger. Top set is a monster: only 88 beats us (rare combo), and the rainbow turn has limited but real draw coverage (gutshots like 76, 64, 79, plus future flush threats once a suit pairs). Villain's IP probe range after a checked-flop is wide — second-pair value (8x, 5x improved), Tx that turned a pair, gutshots, Ax stabs. RAISE captures value from worse made hands and charges draws while building a pot we want to play stack-off in; calling preserves villain's bluff frequency for river but compresses our value extraction at this SPR. Per KB §1.7 default for sets and pure nuts in mixed solver spots, label RAISE.

Hero AhJh on Jc9c5d2sQd literal river facing BTN's 75% pot triple-barrel (25% flop / 33% turn / 75% river). Per interpretation (a) — literal board fields as ground truth — the Q on the river is an overcard to hero's J pair, demoting hero from TPGK to SECOND PAIR + A-blocker. Pot odds = 37.5/125 = 30% equity needed. Villain's polarized triple-barrel value range on this runout is heavy: QQ (rivered top set), KQ/AQ (rivered top pair), J9/JJ/99/55 (sets/two pair), Q-high clubs flushes, plus stronger Jx kickers like KJ/QJ. Hero's A-blocker removes AA/AQ/AJ but does NOT block KQ, QQ, sets, J9, or any flush combos. Bluff candidates after BTN fires three streets on a Q-river: missed KT (broadway gutshot), missed T8/club backdoors — slim. With second pair + partial blocker against a value-heavy polarized triple-barrel range needing 30% equity, the bluff frequency required for indifference is unlikely to be present. FOLD.

Same literal board as LK-05 (Jc9c5d2sQd) but variation upsized villain's river bet to 56.2bb (~112% pot overbet) instead of 37.5bb. Per interpretation (a), Q river demotes hero AhJh to second pair + A-blocker. Pot odds = 56.2/(50+56.2+56.2) = 56.2/162.4 = 34.6% equity needed — higher threshold than LK-05's 30%. Overbet sizing further polarizes villain's range toward strong value (sets/QQ/KQ/AQ/J9/clubs flushes) and the thinnest bluffs only (missed combo draws). With bluff candidates already slim on this runout (KT, T8, busted backdoor clubs), the overbet's higher required bluff frequency makes the call EV worse than LK-05. Hero's A-blocker still removes AA/AQ/AJ but not the bulk of the value range. Second pair + partial blocker vs an overbet polarized triple-barrel = FOLD.
